name: dunjs
description: A secure JavaScript runtime written in D

configurations.name: quickjs
preBuildCommands-posix: test -f $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs/libquickjs.a || (curl -sL https://github.com/nichochar/nichochar.com/quickjs/archive/refs/heads/master.tar.gz -o $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs.tar.gz && mkdir -p $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs && tar -xzf $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs && rm $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs.tar.gz && cd $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/quickjs && make libquickjs.a CC=cc CFLAGS='-fPIC -O2 -DJS_NAN_BOXING=0' 2>/dev/null || true)

configurations.name: v8
preBuildCommands-posix: test -f $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/v8shim/libv8shim.a || (cd $PACKAGE_DIR/vendor/v8shim && test -f v8shim.cpp && g++ -std=c++17 -fPIC -O2 -c v8shim.cpp -o v8shim.o -I/usr/include/v8 && ar rcs libv8shim.a v8shim.o && rm -f v8shim.o || true)
